name: Agents Best Practices
summary: Provider-neutral Agent Skill for designing, auditing and refactoring agentic harnesses in any domain.
description: A markdown-only Agent Skill (SKILL.md plus reference files) for designing, generating MVP blueprints for, auditing, troubleshooting and refactoring agentic harnesses. It covers agent loops, tool permissions, environment-adaptive tools, planning, workflow orchestration, context and memory, evals, observability, prompt caching and checklists. Applies beyond coding agents; works with Codex, Claude Code and other SKILL-compatible runtimes.
contains: SKILL.md entrypoint plus ~20 markdown reference files
Covers agent loops, tool permissions, planning, context and memory, evals and observability
Use cases: MVP agent blueprints, audits, troubleshooting, refactors, adaptive teams, always-on agents
Installs via npx skills add; self-update checks the upstream revision
